# steprs

> Coaxial and stepped hole detection from STEP (ISO 10303-21) in the browser. Local WebAssembly. Files stay on device. Not CAM.

Site: https://steprs.dev/
Source: https://github.com/vladimir-io/step-rs
License: MIT

## Does

- Coaxial stepped bores (aligned cylinders, diameters, segments, depth)
- Through and blind holes
- 3D preview (OpenCascade when possible)
- CSV export
- Client-side only (WASM + Web Worker)

## Does not

- CAM / toolpaths / G-code
- CAD editing
- File upload to a server

## Formats

- Part 21 AP203 / AP214 (`.step` `.stp` `.p21`)
- Lengths in mm

## Dev

- CLI: `cargo run -p steprs-cli -- analyze samples/ap214_compact.step`
- WASM: `analyzeStep(stepText)` -> JSON
- Details: https://github.com/vladimir-io/step-rs/blob/main/README.md
- Longer notes: https://steprs.dev/llms-full.txt
